# A method that is not defined on the receiver gets its signature synthesized
# from the call's arguments, so each argument becomes a parameter named after
# it; a repeated argument would synthesize colliding parameter names.

! muxt generate --use-receiver-type=T
cmpenv stderr want-err.txt

-- want-err.txt --
Error:
  GET / F(request, request)
                   ^^^^^^^
$WORK/template.gohtml:1:30: cannot infer a signature for F: the request argument is passed more than once; define the method on the receiver to use repeated arguments
-- template.gohtml --
{{- define "GET / F(request, request)" -}}ok{{- end -}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type T struct{}
